system.description:
Use a shield as a second weapon without the normal two-weapon attack penalty. It is a Light weapon dealing 1d4 (1d6 for a Tower Shield), and it keeps its AC bonus.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
